I can't finish this one. The statement is a genuine group-theory theorem, and I don't see a short route to a Lean proof.

The mathematical outline I worked out: if G has no normal Sylow p-subgroup, then n_p = p+1 and G acts faithfully and transitively on the p+1 Sylow p-subgroups. That makes G sharply 2-transitive of degree p+1. Showing that p+1 must be a power of 2 then needs Frobenius's theorem or Thompson-style results on fixed-point-free automorphisms. Neither is in Mathlib in a form I could assemble here, and I can't read Mathlib sources to find the right lemmas. I did not modify `/work/fatex_004.lean`; it still contains the `sorry` and compiles with only that warning.

I give up.
